attach: Default text and accessible name of the paperclip button that attaches files to an issue or comment.
pending: Accessible name of the list of files chosen but not uploaded yet.
remove-file: Accessible name of the × on a file chosen but not uploaded yet; {{name}} is the file's name.
attachments: Accessible name of the grid of an issue's attached files.
view-file: Accessible name of an attachment's thumbnail, which opens the file; {{name}} is the file's name.
download-file: Accessible name of the button that downloads an attachment; {{name}} is the file's name.
delete-file: Accessible name of the button that deletes an attachment; {{name}} is the file's name.
upload-failed: One line per file that didn't upload: {{name}} is the file's name, {{reason}} the server's reason.
upload-failed-plain: The same, when the server gave no reason.
download-failed: Toast when an attachment couldn't be downloaded.
components.label: The field with the plugins and apps an issue is about.
components.none: The Components field's value when the issue is about no plugin or app.
components.remove: Accessible name of the × beside a chosen component; {{name}} is its name.
components.add: Button in the Components field that opens the list of plugins and apps to pick from.
components.loading: Text of that button while the list of plugins and apps loads.
components.search: Accessible name of the search box in that list.
components.search-placeholder: Placeholder of the search box in the Components field's list of plugins and apps an issue can be about.
components.group.all: Group of the two choices that stand for every plugin or every app.
components.group.plugins: Heading of the group of plugins in the component list. Plugins add pages and tools to the app.
components.group.apps: Heading of the group of mini apps people published in the workspace.
components.off: After a plugin's name: an admin turned it off.
components.no-match: In the component list when nothing matches the search.
components.full: When the most components are chosen; the count is that limit.
